plugins.name: unslop-ui
plugins.description: Cut AI tells from interface and chart copy: eyebrow labels, 01/02/03 numbering, captions that explain what is visible, decorative badges, icons and status dots, arrows on links, generic link names and filler words. With --surface it also fixes gradients, edge accent bars, off-scale spacing, heavy weights and decorative motion. With --plan it shows its cuts and waits for your OK.
